limitations: Four complete 1k cold/warm pairs passed original gates; fifth failed before usable observer evidence, not a measured product RSS failure.
The mismatching kernel command sample was not retained, so its value and exact cause are unknown; a transient observation is a hypothesis, not a proven race.
Original matrix record is stale running after actual outer exit 1; preserved byte exact and supplemented by separate terminal observation.

The original observer can raise after spawn without reaping; the harness loses the usage record and the matrix cannot handle missing process evidence. All exact private servers are confirmed gone now.
Next observer must persist PID before validation, keep bounded mismatch samples, require exact eventual identity, always reap after actual exit and preserve wait4 usage even on identity failure.
No equivalent rerun of unchanged observer; a different corrected observer requires fresh evidence names and all five rounds. Existing four are not a completed five-round qualification.
Prior original three-scale/five-round direct-package cache, complete LSP, Linux hosts and single ordinary-edit controls retain their separate scope.
